reason: H0 retains adequate entry-point, streaming-state, input, and configuration control for the changed JSON trailer behavior. fuzz_complex repeatedly calls wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens with varied source and token-buffer limits, while set_quirks independently controls the relevant numeric quirk values through the existing WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_ALLOW_TRAILING_COMMENT and WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_ALLOW_TRAILING_NEW_LINE identifiers. In S1 those identifiers are deprecated aliases with the same values as WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_ALLOW_TRAILING_FILLER and WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_EXPECT_TRAILING_NEW_LINE_OR_EOF, respectively. Consequently H0 can enable either new semantic mode, combine them with WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_ALLOW_COMMENT_BLOCK or WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_ALLOW_COMMENT_LINE, reach the new bad-quirk-combination path, and supply arbitrary trailing bytes. The renamed internal helper does not create a new public entry point or protocol requirement.
evidence: set_quirks includes WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_ALLOW_TRAILING_COMMENT, WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_ALLOW_TRAILING_NEW_LINE, WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_ALLOW_COMMENT_BLOCK, and WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_ALLOW_COMMENT_LINE, with each selected from hash_44_bits.
S1 defines WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_ALLOW_TRAILING_FILLER and WUFFS_JSON__QUIRK_ALLOW_TRAILING_COMMENT as 1225364497.

fuzz_complex calls wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens in a loop, varies tok_limit and src_limit through buffer_limit, handles short_read and short_write, and passes the complete fuzz input through full_src.
The changed wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens invokes wuffs_json__decoder__decode_trailer based on f_quirks[17] or f_quirks[18], both already controllable through H0's alias identifiers.
The new bad-quirk-combination check involving f_quirks[18] with f_quirks[11], f_quirks[12], or f_quirks[17] is reachable through H0's independently hash-selected quirk list.
recommended_action: No harness maintenance is needed for this commit; optionally rename the two deprecated quirk identifiers in set_quirks for clarity, without changing fuzz coverage.
